instruction.thesis: OIL WTI spot has surged from $96.88 at entry baseline to $101.28 — a +4.54% move. The position is short via buying NO on 'Will WTI hit LOW $90 in May?' The YES price has risen from 0.40 to 0.64, meaning the NO position has lost ~60% of its value. The thesis was that WTI would NOT dip to $90 in May, which remains directionally correct (spot is moving away from $90 upward), but the YES price rising to 0.64 means the market is now pricing a 64% chance of a $90 dip despite spot at $101 — this is a market quality/liquidity issue. More critically, the position has already realized a 60% loss on the NO side. The oil_wti_spot evidence column shows clear adverse movement and the position is well past any reasonable hold threshold given the loss magnitude. Close to prevent further deterioration.

instruction.thesis: BTC long entered at $79,093 via H-145 (BTC put-call exhaustion reversal). BTC spot has drifted to $79,080, essentially flat but with the P/C ratio now signaling the bearish phase. The position is within 0.02% of entry but the signal family evidence (btc_spot flat, P/C ratio spiked) indicates the thesis has shifted from bullish reversal to potential further weakness. With only a 1.5% stop and the signal now pointing bearish per H-145's own logic, closing here preserves capital before the stop is hit.
